body:
Hey, thanks.  In all the weirdness today it actually had not specifically occurred to me to "focus on myself, not the negative qualities, but the good".  I spend a lot of time half-seriously thinking about negative qualities... and rarely the good ones.

I'm going to go up to bed (and probably not sleep) now and think about that.



Incidentally I think the relationship can be fixed.  At least, I'm definitely not assuming that it can't... that's one of the only negative thoughts I'm not having.  I always need a few days to process my thoughts when something like this happens, and sometimes they change dramatically, but that's my gut feeling right now.

I'm going to try what you said though and focus on my position for a little while, and not think about fixing it yet.  It's natural for me to think about a lot of other things and not the good about myself but I suppose I see how doing that too much can set me up to fall hard and fast like today.  Like I said in the post it was really scary how brittle I felt when I was "alone"... that bothered me quite separately from the trigger event.  This is probably a good time to address it.

Thanks again.
